notes.title: GRAND FINAL of the IWC "Imperivm World Cup" eSport Championship.
notes.content:
It is a pleasure to announce the GRAND FINAL of the IWC - Imperivm World Cup tournament, the first official Imperivm HD eSport Championship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40969168/e02212a2b13fd3e31a10ae7466b7eb891e998480.jpg

The definitive and most anticipated showdown has finally arrived to meet the best Imperivm HD team and players.

It will be this Sunday, December 12, starting at 19:00 (7:00 PM) and broadcast live on the Twitch channel of Imperivm World.

https://www.twitch.tv/imperivmworld

The team formed by GLADIADOR, HALCÓN, and SULY, the best Spanish players, will face the team of DAVE and SUNSET, the Italian brothers who seem unbeatable.

Only one team can remain. May the best win.

The first official Imperivm HD eSport competition is having great acceptance among players with good participation and audience results.

IWC - Imperivm World Cup has 20 teams, more than 50 players, more than 50 games, and more than 12,000 spectators in its first edition.

With a “jackpot” of $1,500 and the raffle of three high-end “gaming chairs”, it becomes the tournament organized by the Imperivm World Community that will distribute the most prizes to date.

We hope to see you all on an unforgettable evening.

https://www.twitch.tv/imperivmworld

Thank you all.
